<script>
  (function () {
    var default_name = 'app.py';
    var copy_svg = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"/></svg>';
    var dl_svg = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>';
    var activeText = function (editor) {
      var scroller = editor.querySelector('.cm-scroller');
      var content = editor.querySelector('.cm-content');
      if (!scroller || !content) return Promise.resolve('');
      var origScroll = scroller.scrollTop;
      var lines = new Map();
      var step = Math.max(120, scroller.clientHeight * 0.7);
      var positions = [];
      for (var y = 0; y < scroller.scrollHeight; y += step) positions.push(y);
      positions.push(scroller.scrollHeight);
      return positions.reduce(function (chain, y) {
        return chain.then(function () {
          scroller.scrollTop = y;
          return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 16); });
        }).then(function () {
          content.querySelectorAll('.cm-line').forEach(function (l) { lines.set(l.offsetTop, l.textContent); });
        });
      }, Promise.resolve()).then(function () {
        scroller.scrollTop = origScroll;
        return Array.from(lines.entries()).sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; }).map(function (e) { return e[1]; }).join('\n');
      });
    };
    var activeFilename = function (editor) {
      var sel = editor.querySelector('.editor-files button.selected .editor-filename');
      return (sel && sel.textContent.trim()) || default_name;
    };
    var flash = function (btn, label) {
      var prev = btn.getAttribute('aria-label');
      btn.classList.add('copied-flash');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
      setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('copied-flash'); btn.setAttribute('aria-label', prev); }, 900);
    };
    var addButtons = function (editor) {
      if (editor.dataset.a11yvizButtonsAdded === '1') return;
      var actions = editor.querySelector('.editor-actions');
      if (!actions) return;
      editor.dataset.a11yvizButtonsAdded = '1';
      var copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
      copyBtn.type = 'button';
      copyBtn.className = 'code-run-button';
      copyBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy code');
      copyBtn.innerHTML = copy_svg;
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!navigator.clipboard) return;
        activeText(editor).then(function (text) {
          if (!text) return;
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash(copyBtn, 'Copied'); });
        });
      });
      var dlBtn = document.createElement('button');
      dlBtn.type = 'button';
      dlBtn.className = 'code-run-button';
      dlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Download file');
      dlBtn.innerHTML = dl_svg;
      dlBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        activeText(editor).then(function (text) {
          if (!text) return;
          var blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
          var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url; a.download = activeFilename(editor);
          document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
          setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 0);
        });
      });
      actions.appendChild(copyBtn);
      actions.appendChild(dlBtn);
    };
    var initCols = function (container) {
      if (container.dataset.a11yvizCols === '1') return;
      container.dataset.a11yvizCols = '1';
      var stacked = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 720px)').matches;
      container.style.gridTemplateColumns = stacked ? '1fr' : '2fr 3fr';
    };
    var sweep = function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.shinylive-container.editor-viewer').forEach(initCols);
      document.querySelectorAll('.shinylive-editor').forEach(addButtons);
    };
    if (document.readyState !== 'loading') sweep();
    else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', sweep);
    new MutationObserver(sweep).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  })();
</script>

## file: chart.py
# Edit the chart. Re-run (Ctrl+Shift+Enter) to update both panels and the audit.

from plotnine import (ggplot, aes, geom_point, geom_text, labs,
                      scale_color_manual, theme)
from plotnine.data import penguins
from a11yviz import a11y_palette, theme_a11y, a11y_alt_text

penguins  = penguins.dropna()
centroids = penguins.groupby("species", as_index=False).agg(
    flipper_length_mm=("flipper_length_mm", "mean"),
    body_mass_g=("body_mass_g", "mean"),
)

def base_plot():
    return (
        ggplot(penguins, aes("flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", color="species"))
        + geom_point()
        + labs(title="Penguins (default plotnine)")
    )

def a11y_plot(level):
    pal_name = "aaa_5" if level == "AAA" else "dark2_8"
    palette = a11y_palette(pal_name, n=penguins["species"].nunique())
    p = (
        ggplot(penguins, aes("flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", color="species"))
        + geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.75)
        + scale_color_manual(values=palette)
        + geom_text(data=centroids, mapping=aes(label="species"),
                    color="black", size=10, fontweight="bold",
                    show_legend=False)
        + theme_a11y(level=level)
        + labs(title="Penguins (theme_a11y + a11y_palette)",
               x="Flipper length (mm)", y="Body mass (g)", color="Species")
        + theme(legend_position="top")
    )
    return a11y_alt_text(
        p,
        "Penguin body mass vs flipper length by species, AA accessible.",
    )

## file: app.py
from pathlib import Path
from shiny import App, ui, render, reactive
import pandas as pd
import itables
from itables import to_html_datatable
from a11yviz import a11y_audit_chart, a11y_audit_actionable

from chart import base_plot, a11y_plot

itables.options.warn_on_undocumented_option = False

app_dir   = Path(__file__).parent
panel_css = (app_dir / "styles.css").read_text()

audit_opts = {"dom": "t", "ordering": False,
              "columnDefs": [{"className": "dt-left", "targets": "_all"}]}

def panel_body(plot_id, audit_id):
    return ui.TagList(
        ui.div(
            ui.output_plot(plot_id, height="100%", width="100%"),
            class_="plot-wrap",
        ),
        ui.div(ui.output_ui(audit_id), class_="table-responsive"),
    )

app_ui = ui.page_fillable(
    ui.tags.head(ui.tags.style(panel_css)),
    ui.input_radio_buttons(
        "level", "WCAG level:",
        choices=["AA", "AAA"], selected="AA", inline=True,
    ),
    ui.navset_underline(
        ui.nav_panel("Baseline", panel_body("plot_before", "audit_before")),
        ui.nav_panel("Accessible", panel_body("plot_after",  "audit_after")),
    ),
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @reactive.calc
    def base():
        return base_plot()

    @reactive.calc
    def accessible():
        return a11y_plot(input.level())

    @render.plot(dpi=96)
    def plot_before():
        return base()

    @render.plot(dpi=96)
    def plot_after():
        return accessible()

    def audit_table(p):
        rows = a11y_audit_actionable(a11y_audit_chart(p, level=input.level()))
        return ui.HTML(to_html_datatable(
            pd.DataFrame(rows),
            caption="Audit", classes="compact stripe hover",
            showIndex=False, **audit_opts))

    @render.ui
    def audit_before():
        return audit_table(base())

    @render.ui
    def audit_after():
        return audit_table(accessible())

app = App(app_ui, server)
